purpose: One campaign-scoped, read-only, pinned audit identity that remains available through the campaign and is explicitly archived and unpinned at accepted-live closure.

rules.active: ACTIVE means read_only=true and pinned=true; it is a campaign-scoped observation identity, not Product writer custody or acceptance authority.
rules.closure: ACCEPTED_LIVE_CLOSED requires the exact active sentinel to be transformed into ARCHIVED_UNPINNED with an archive time and reason in the same canonical lifecycle transition.
rules.portability: The sentinel binds only portable role and campaign identities. Host/session capability and live-site evidence remain external adapter boundaries.
